1:
AN ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH A PROCEDURE AND A FEE SCHEDULE FOR THE REVIEW OF PLANS THAT ARE SUBMITTED TO THE BUILDING DEPARTMENT OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN FOR THE PURPOSE OF OBTAINING A

PERMIT FOR THE FABRICATION, ERECTION. CONSTRUCTION, ENLARGE MENT, ALTERATION, OR REPAIR OF BUILDINGS AND STRUCTURES.
2:
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN that when deemed necessary by the City/County Inspector, said plans shall be forwarded to the Southern Building Code Congress International, Inc. (SBCCI) for their review and comments. : °

BE_ IT FURTHER ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL that when plans are required by the City/County Inspector to be reviewed by the Southern Building Code Congress International, Inc., a non-refundable plan review fee shall be paid to the City/County Inspector by the applicant prior to the time application is made for a building permit. Said fee shall be in accordance with the schedule established from time to time by the SBCCI.

BE IT FURTHER .ORDAINED that this Ordinance shall take effect and be in force upon its adoption.

PASSED -:AND APPROVED by the City Council of the Town of Pine Mountain on the 12th.day of Juhe, 1989.
